Our team manages a shared AI assistant configuration directory at `~/.claude` containing skills, commands, and settings. We've been accumulating backup archives in `~/openclaw-backups/` and the folder is getting out of hand — there are already 5 old archives sitting there.

I need you to do three things:
1. Create a fresh skills-only archive of our current configuration and save it to the `~/openclaw-backups/` directory.
2. Generate an integrity verification file alongside the new archive so we can validate it later.
3. Enforce a retention policy of **3 most recent backups** — after creating the new archive, prune the backup directory so only the 3 newest archives remain.

Please handle everything using standard shell tools already available on this machine.
